sql: SELECT s.created_at, s.raw_json->>'events_optin' AS ev_optin, s.raw_json->>'markets_considered_optin' AS mk_optin, s.raw_json->>'events_seen' AS ev_seen, (SELECT count(*) FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy='Tempmmsell1') AS temp_trades, (SELECT min(p.created_at) FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy='Tempmmsell1') AS first_trade, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',1), ',') FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy='Tempmmsell1') AS series FROM system_events s WHERE s.component='mmsell_scan' ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 6
